verses.text: Ab'ek wal ex wetchonhab' Israel. Toxo ix k'och stiempoal yik tze k'axpitan ha' Jordán, yik tze satanel juntzanh chonhab' te niwak, te tek'an t'a eyichanh, te chaanh yajk'e smuroal.
Ha heb' anima kajan ta', chaanh steel heb', a winhaj Anac ay yinhtilal heb'. Ix eyab' yalji: ¿Mach wal junok syal stek'b'an sb'a t'a yichanh heb' yinhtilal winhaj Anac? xchi heb'.

Ojtakejekel tiknaik to a Jehová ko Diosal, a b'ab'el sb'at t'a eyichanh icha junok k'ak' satanel masanil tastak. Ol ak'jokoch heb' t'a yol he k'ab', yuj chi' ol he satnhejel heb', ol he pechanel heb' t'a elanhchamel, icha ix aj yalan Jehová.

Ayik toxo ix yik'el masanil heb' anima chi' Jehová t'a eyichanh, manh he na' to yuj he wach'il, yuj chi' icha chi' ix aji. Palta yuj schukal juntzanh chonhab' chi' ol ik'jokel heb' t'a eyichanh yuj Jehová.

Manh yujok he wach'il, manh yujok pax swach'il he b'eyb'al yuj chi' ol ex k'och kajan t'a sat lu'um. Palta yuj schukal juntzanh chonhab' chi', ol satjokkanel heb' t'a eyichanh, yik wach' tz'elkank'och tas yalnak Jehová t'a heb' ko mam kicham, haton t'a winhaj Abraham, t'a winhaj Isaac yet' t'a winhaj Jacob.
Ojtakejekel an to manh yujok he wach'il syak' jun lum manh jantakok swach'il chi' Jehová t'ayex yik tzeyikej, palta a ex tik junelnhej te pit ex.
Naekkoti, b'at talaj satk'olal eyuuj to he tzuntzejnakkot yowal Jehová t'a eyib'anh t'a tzinan lu'um. Atax kelnakkot t'a Egipto masanto onh jawi t'a tik, te pitnhej tzeyutej he b'a t'ay.
Ha t'a lum witz Horeb he tzuntzejnak wal kot yowal, yuj chi' snib'ejnak ex sateli.

Ayik in k'e t'a sjolom jun witz chi' yuj in chaan chab' pachanh k'een k'een b'aj tz'ib'ab'iloch cheknab'il, haton strato Dios ket'ok, 40 k'ual yet' 40 ak'wal eq'uin ta', malaj jab'ok tas in wa''a, ma wuk'ej.

Slajwi chi', yak'an chab' pachanh k'een k'een chi' Jehová t'ayin. Ha wal Jehová chi' tz'ib'anoch scheknab'il chi' t'a k'een, juntzanh cheknab'il yalnak t'a jolom witz t'a kal k'ak' t'a jun k'u ayik molan onh ek' ta'.
Ayik slajwi yek'kanb'at 40 k'ual yet' 40 ak'wal chi', yak'an chab' k'een yik trato chi' t'ayin.
Yalan icha tik: Emanhxi t'a elanhchamel, yujto a jun chonhab' ix ik'elta t'a Egipto toxo ix sjuel sb'a. Max sk'anab'ajejlaj tas ix wala', toxo ix sb'o jun sdiosal heb' nab'a oro.
Toxo ix wila'' to te pit jun chonhab' tik.

Nitzel a b'a t'a wichanh, ol in satel juntzanh anima tik, manhxa b'aj ol b'inaj heb' t'a sat lu'um tik. Anhej t'a inhtilal ol in b'o junok niwan nakión, te tek'an ol ajok, tzijtum ol aj sb'isul t'a yichanh juntzanh anima tik, xchi Jehová.
Wemxita t'a jolom witz b'aj nhilnhon sk'e k'ak' chi', wet'nak chab' k'een yik trato chi'.
Haxo wemxuli, wilani to toxo ix och he mul t'a yol sat Jehová ko Diosal, yujto he b'o jun yechel wakax he diosalok. Jun wal rato eyik'el he b'a t'a spatik cheknab'il yal ko Diosal chi' t'ayonh.
Yuj chi', in pok'anem chab' pachanh k'een k'een chi' t'a eyichanh, spojb'at k'een.

Slajwi chi' wemxi nhojan t'a yichanh Jehová t'a 40 k'ual yet' 40 ak'wal. Maj in wa jab'ok, maj wuk'ej jab'ok ha' eyuuj, yuj chi' icha chi' in k'ulej, yujto te chuk he k'ulej, he tzuntzejkot yowal sk'ol Jehová.
Te xiw in yujto kot yowal sk'ol Jehová chi' t'a eyib'anh yik tzex sataneli. Palta jun, yab'to Jehová tas wal t'ay junelxo chi'.
Kotpax yowal t'a winh wuk'tak aj Aarón, jab'xonhej maj satjokel winh yuj. Palta tewi in yuj winh yik tz'ak'ji niwank'olal winh.
Elanhchamel in mak'em weknaj jun yechel wakax b'aj och he mul chi'. Elanhchamel in yumb'at t'a kal k'ak'. Slajwi chi' in tenan pojok, in tzipankanb'at t'a yol ha ha' tz'emta t'a lum witz chi'.
Icha chi' he k'ulejpax t'a Tabera, t'a Masah yet' t'a Kibrot-hataawa. Ha wal ta' he tzuntzejkot yowal sk'ol Jehová.

Haton yik yalan Jehová chi' t'ayonh t'a Cades-barnea to tzonh b'at kik' lum ix yak' t'ayonh. Hanhejtona' ta' he tenek' tas yal ko Diosal chi'. Maj eyak'ochlaj t'a he k'ool, maj he k'anab'ajej pax tas yala'.
Atax yik ex wojtakaneli woch ijan wilani to te pitnhej tzeyutej he b'a t'a Jehová.
Yujto maj he k'anab'ajej, yuj chi' yala' to ol ex satelok, yuj chi' em in nhojan t'a yichanh t'a 40 k'ual yet' 40 ak'wal chi'.
Walan t'ay icha tik: Mamin Jehová, manh a satel jun a chonhab' tik. Ha ach ix a kolel yet' ipal, ix ik'anelta t'a Egipto yet' a poder.
Nakot tas alnakkan t'a heb' a chekab', haton winhaj Abraham, winhaj Isaac yet' winhaj Jacob. Ha spital juntzanh anima tik yet' smul heb' yet' schuk pensaril heb', manh a nakoti,

yik wach' max yal heb' anima b'aj ix onh ik'elta chi': Maj yal-laj yuj Jehová yik'ank'och jun chonhab' chi' t'a lum b'aj yak'nak sti' yak'an t'a heb', anhej to ix yik'b'at heb' yik b'at yak'ancham heb' t'a takinh lu'um yujto chakb'ilel heb' yuj, xcham heb'.
Ak' niwank'olal t'a jun chonhab'il anima tik, yujto a chonhab' yaji. Ha ach ix ik'elta t'a Egipto yet' a poder, xin chi t'ay.
